noCard.title: Don't have a Soil Health Card?
noCard.subtitle: You can get one easily through government initiatives or try FasalSaathi now.
noCard.whatIsTitle: What is a Soil Health Card?
noCard.whatIsText: A government-issued report that details 12 important soil nutrient levels and recommends crop-specific fertilizer doses.
noCard.step1: 1. Collect soil: Take 500g of soil from 8–10 spots across your field (depth of 15 cm). Mix thoroughly.
noCard.step2: 2. Submit sample: Hand it to your local Krishi Vigyan Kendra (KVK), block agriculture office, or PACCS.
noCard.step3: 3. Receive card: Testing costs only ₹30–₹50 under the Soil Health Scheme. Results arrive in 2–3 weeks.

cropDetail.title: Detailed Suitability Breakdown for
cropDetail.basedOn: Deterministic scoring calculated across 9 agronomic factors
cropDetail.soilPhSuitable: Soil pH is optimal for nutrient uptake
cropDetail.soilPhNotIdeal: Soil pH deviates from the ideal range; consider lime or gypsum
cropDetail.nitrogenGood: Available Nitrogen is in a healthy range for vegetative growth
cropDetail.nitrogenLow: Nitrogen is low; basal application of urea or compost recommended
cropDetail.phosphorusGood: Phosphorus is adequate for strong root development
cropDetail.phosphorusLow: Phosphorus is deficient; apply DAP or SSP before sowing
cropDetail.potassiumGood: Potassium level is sufficient for disease resistance and grain quality
cropDetail.potassiumLow: Potassium is low; consider MOP (Muriate of Potash)
cropDetail.organicCarbonGood: Organic Carbon is adequate for microbial activity and water retention
cropDetail.organicCarbonLow: Organic Carbon is low; add farmyard manure (FYM) or green manure
cropDetail.tempSuitable: Current and seasonal temperature is well within growth limits
cropDetail.tempNotIdeal: Temperature is on the edge of the crop's preferred range
cropDetail.humiditySuitable: Atmospheric humidity supports healthy canopy growth
cropDetail.humidityNotIdeal: Humidity may increase fungal risk or reduce pollination
cropDetail.rainSuitable: Rainfall and moisture conditions align with crop water demand
cropDetail.rainNotIdeal: Rainfall expectations differ from ideal crop requirement
